preconditions.expression: all(1 <= int(x) <= 3000 for x in (m, n)) and n <= m
preconditions.description: m and n are integers where 1 ≤ n ≤ m ≤ 3000, representing the number of players and the number of top results Ostap remembers, respectively.

preconditions.expression: len(points) == n and all(0 <= int(p) <= 2 * m for p in points)
preconditions.description: The second line contains exactly n non-negative integers (points), each ≤ 2·m, representing the top n player scores in non-ascending order.

preconditions.expression: points == sorted([int(p) for p in points], reverse=True)
preconditions.description: The input points are already provided in non-ascending order.

postconditions.expression: stdout.strip() == 'no' or (stdout.strip() == 'yes' and len(tournament_table) == m and all(len(row) == m for row in tournament_table))
postconditions.description: If no valid tournament exists, output is exactly 'no'. Otherwise, output starts with 'yes' followed by m lines of m characters each ('X', 'W', 'D', 'L'), where 'X' is on the main diagonal, and the table represents a consistent tournament.

postconditions.expression: stdout.strip() == 'yes' and (tournament_table := [line.strip() for line in stdout.splitlines()[1:]]) and all(tournament_table[i][i] == 'X' for i in range(m))
postconditions.description: The tournament table has 'X' on the main diagonal (i.e., no player plays against themselves).

postconditions.expression: stdout.strip() == 'yes' and (tournament_table := [line.strip() for line in stdout.splitlines()[1:]]) and (player_points := [sum(2 if tournament_table[i][j] == 'W' else 1 if tournament_table[i][j] == 'D' else 0 for j in range(m)) for i in range(m)]) and sorted(player_points, reverse=True)[:n] == [int(p) for p in points]
postconditions.description: The top n player scores in the tournament table match Ostap's remembered points exactly when sorted in non-ascending order.

postconditions.expression: stdout.strip() == 'yes' and (tournament_table := [line.strip() for line in stdout.splitlines()[1:]]) and all(tournament_table[i][j] in {'W', 'L', 'D'} for i in range(m) for j in range(m) if i != j) and all(tournament_table[i][j] == 'L' if tournament_table[j][i] == 'W' else tournament_table[i][j] == 'W' if tournament_table[j][i] == 'L' else tournament_table[i][j] == 'D' if tournament_table[j][i] == 'D' else True for i in range(m) for j in range(m) if i != j)
postconditions.description: The tournament table is consistent: for every pair of players (i, j), if i beats j ('W'), then j loses to i ('L'), and if they draw ('D'), it is mutual. No other combinations are allowed.
